acceptanceCriteria: The workflow guidance is emitted at SessionStart and after compaction only, not on every UserPromptSubmit.
SessionStart in a subagent session emits only what the subagent needs, if the hook input identifies a subagent; otherwise the limit is recorded.
Measured per-day bytes before and after are recorded.
Maintained adapter tests pin the new output.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the owner-requested token-usage audit (owner: ensure Corvint and corvint-tasks are optimal with token usage at all times). Measured on rc3-cleanup head 79536edd and 72 h of this project's Claude Code transcripts; tokens about bytes/4.

Measured: UserPromptSubmit fires about 420 times a day (task notifications count) and averages 1,658 B, about 700 KB a day; 548 B of each is the fixed workflow argv guidance, whose key and root never change within a session (cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:654). SessionStart averages 2,307 B, fires about 154 times a day, and 295 of 463 fired inside subagents (host_adapter.go:376). Every injection stays in the transcript and is re-read each later turn.
